en.summary: This mixed hardware commit fixes SIMD sub-packet bookkeeping by correcting packet-id sizing across execution units and by making operand-collection iteration advance only on true dispatch consumption.
why_it_counts: The changes are in core RTL, not only in tracing or tests.
Several execution units change PID_BITS from a SIMD-width-based expression to a NUM_THREADS-based expression, which directly affects per-packet tags.
VX_opc_unit.sv and VX_nz_iterator.sv fix dispatch-side packet iteration and dequeue timing, which is central to sub-packet sequencing.
disqualifiers: The commit bundles more than one closely related SIMD packet-bookkeeping fix; the injection plan targets the common packet bookkeeping mechanism.
evidence: hw/rtl/core/VX_alu_int.sv, VX_alu_muldiv.sv, VX_csr_unit.sv, VX_fpu_unit.sv, VX_lsu_slice.sv, and VX_pe_switch.sv all change PID_BITS to use NUM_THREADS / NUM_LANES.
hw/rtl/core/VX_opc_unit.sv changes iterator advance and dequeue handling so the operand collector advances on output consumption rather than on staging progress.
hw/rtl/libs/VX_nz_iterator.sv rewrites enable, SOP, EOP, and valid tracking to advance with the actual iterator enable.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: When a warp or vector instruction is broken into multiple sub-packets, the hardware must both identify each sub-packet with enough bits and advance the sub-packet iterator only when a packet is actually consumed downstream. If packet identifiers are too narrow, or if the iterator advances on an earlier staging event rather than true dequeue, packets can alias, repeat, or be skipped. That breaks result tagging and instruction progression for multi-packet execution.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: Sub-packet ID sizing and iterator advance for SIMD issue
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: An instruction spans multiple SIMD or subwarp packets, especially under output backpressure or when NUM_THREADS exceeds one packet width.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Under-size the sub-packet ID field or advance the packet iterator on a pre-consumption handshake instead of on the real downstream consume event.
portability_notes: Map this to any vector, SIMT, or tensor issue path that emits one instruction as multiple packets.
The bug can be injected either in the packet tag-width definition or in the iterator/dequeue handshake, as long as packet identity and progression become inconsistent.
It is most portable on designs where result tags or sideband state carry a packet ID across pipeline stages.
concrete_injection_steps: Derive the packet-ID width from the active lane width instead of from the full number of packets that one instruction may generate.
Or, keep the packet-ID width unchanged but make the iterator advance when an upstream staging buffer fires instead of when the downstream consumer accepts a packet.
Do not change downstream tag consumers so packet aliasing or skipped packets propagate into execute and writeback stages.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Operand collector SIMD iterator and packet-ID width definitions
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix changes packet-ID width calculations from SIMD_WIDTH-based sizing to NUM_THREADS-based sizing across execution units and reworks the operand-collector iterator to advance on true dequeue.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Restore PID_BITS expressions that use SIMD_WIDTH / NUM_LANES, and in VX_opc_unit.sv plus VX_nz_iterator.sv drive iterator next or state reset from staging fire style conditions instead of the final dequeue/enable event.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Multi-packet instructions can duplicate, skip, or mis-tag sub-packets, leading to wrong per-packet results, bad writeback association, or stuck progress under backpressure.
evidence_for_injection: The same PID_BITS formula change appears in multiple execution units, which indicates a real cross-unit packet-ID sizing bug rather than formatting noise.
VX_opc_unit.sv explicitly changes dequeue and operand reset timing around packet dispatch.
VX_nz_iterator.sv changes the iterator's valid, sop, and eop behavior to be driven by actual enable conditions.
notes: Because the commit bundles related packet-bookkeeping fixes, this entry focuses on the shared sub-packet identity and progression mechanism.
The easiest reinjection point is usually the iterator handshake in the operand collector or the packet-ID width constant used in tags.

zh.summary: 该混合硬件提交修复了 SIMD 子包的状态维护问题：一方面修正了各执行单元中的 packet-id 位宽，另一方面让操作数收集器的迭代器只在真正被下游消费时前进。
why_it_counts: 改动发生在核心 RTL 中，而不是仅限于 trace 或测试。
多个执行单元把 PID_BITS 从基于 SIMD 宽度的表达式改成了基于 NUM_THREADS 的表达式，这会直接影响子包标签。
VX_opc_unit.sv 和 VX_nz_iterator.sv 修复了分发侧的子包迭代与出队时机，这是多子包执行的核心机制。
disqualifiers: 该提交打包了多个彼此相关的 SIMD 子包状态修复；本条目的注入计划聚焦它们共同的子包维护机制。
evidence: hw/rtl/core/VX_alu_int.sv、VX_alu_muldiv.sv、VX_csr_unit.sv、VX_fpu_unit.sv、VX_lsu_slice.sv 和 VX_pe_switch.sv 都把 PID_BITS 改成使用 NUM_THREADS / NUM_LANES。
hw/rtl/core/VX_opc_unit.sv 修改了迭代器前进与出队逻辑，使操作数收集器在输出真正被消费时才前进。
hw/rtl/libs/VX_nz_iterator.sv 重写了 enable、SOP、EOP 和 valid 的维护逻辑，使其与真实的迭代器使能相一致。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 当一个 warp 或向量指令被拆成多个子包执行时，硬件既要用足够宽的字段标识每个子包，也要保证迭代器只在子包真正被下游接收时才推进。如果 packet identifier 位宽过窄，或者迭代器在更早的 staging 事件上推进而不是在真实出队时推进，就会出现子包别名、重复或丢失，从而破坏多子包执行中的结果标记和指令推进。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: SIMD 发射中的子包 ID 位宽与迭代器推进
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 一条指令会跨越多个 SIMD 或 subwarp 子包，尤其是在输出存在回压或者 NUM_THREADS 大于单包宽度时。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 把子包 ID 字段做窄，或者让子包迭代器在预消费握手上推进，而不是在真实下游消费事件上推进。
portability_notes: 可映射到任何把一条指令拆成多个包发出的向量、SIMT 或 tensor 发射路径。
只要让包的身份标识与推进时机不一致，就可以通过标签位宽定义或迭代器握手来注入该故障。
若设计会在流水线旁带状态或结果标签中携带 packet ID，该故障最容易移植。
concrete_injection_steps: 把 packet-ID 的位宽从完整子包数量推导，改成只依据活动 lane 宽度推导。
或者保持位宽不变，但让迭代器在上游 staging buffer fire 时前进，而不是在下游真正接受子包时前进。
不要修改下游标签消费者，使子包别名或丢包继续传播到执行与写回阶段。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: 操作数收集器中的 SIMD 迭代器与 packet-ID 位宽定义
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该修复在多个执行单元中把 packet-ID 的位宽计算从基于 SIMD_WIDTH 改为基于 NUM_THREADS，并重构了操作数收集器的迭代器，使其只在真实出队时前进。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 把各执行单元中的 PID_BITS 表达式改回使用 SIMD_WIDTH / NUM_LANES，并在 VX_opc_unit.sv 与 VX_nz_iterator.sv 中让迭代器的 next 或状态复位重新依赖 staging fire 一类条件，而不是最终 dequeue/enable 事件。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 多子包指令会出现子包重复、丢失或标记错误，进而导致每包结果错误、写回关联错误，或在回压下出现停滞。
evidence_for_injection: 相同的 PID_BITS 公式修正出现在多个执行单元，说明这是真实的跨单元 packet-ID 位宽错误，而不是格式整理。
VX_opc_unit.sv 明确修改了围绕包分发的 dequeue 与操作数复位时序。
VX_nz_iterator.sv 让 iterator 的 valid、sop 和 eop 行为改由真实 enable 条件驱动。
notes: 由于该提交打包了若干相关的 packet-bookkeeping 修复，本条目聚焦它们共同的子包身份和推进机制。
最容易的回注点通常是操作数收集器中的迭代器握手，或标签中使用的 packet-ID 位宽常量。
